laser.intro: Skin aging involves not just wrinkles but also structural changes in skin thickness, collagen, fat layers, and elasticity. Dittocell uses precise diagnosis with the latest equipment and customized programs to deliver safer, more satisfying results.

items.name: Ultherapy Prime
items.desc: DeepSEE™ technology expands the treatment screen by 35% with 2x larger ultrasound field for more precise customized treatment. With depth-specific tips (1.5mm, 3.0mm, 4.5mm), it precisely improves nasolabial folds, sagging cheeks, double chin, and neck wrinkles.

items.name: Thermage FLX
items.desc: Pre-heats the dermis with Genesis laser before Thermage treatment for therapeutic effects from the very first shot. At optimal 60-65℃ temperature, it activates collagen contraction and regeneration to tighten cheeks, nasolabial folds, and jawline.

items.name: Sofwave
items.desc: SUPERB™ ultrasound technology precisely heats the mid-dermis at 1.5mm depth. 7 parallel ultrasound beams deliver uniform energy while Sofcool™ cooling system protects the skin surface and promotes collagen production.

items.name: Neoface
items.desc: Three types of energy (high, mid, low frequency) work at different depths to induce stretched collagen contraction and regeneration. Delicate design creates natural and elegant beauty.

items.name: Shrink Universe
items.desc: Two ultrasound modes (dot & line type) with 7 cartridges enable customized treatment. Ultra booster handpiece precisely cares for narrow and curved areas with 2.5x faster treatment speed while reducing pain and increasing effectiveness.

items.name: Oligio X
items.desc: Delivers 6.78MHz RF energy with up to 400W output to dermis and muscle layers. Real-time impedance measurement ensures accurate energy delivery with 2.25x enhanced cooling system for safe and effective lifting.

items.name: Sylfirm X
items.desc: US FDA and Korean KFDA certified dual RF microneedling device. CW (continuous wave) and PW (pulse wave) modes improve melasma, redness, pores, and acne scars with 15-20 minute treatment allowing immediate return to daily activities.

items.name: Alltight
items.desc: Next-generation lifting device with DLTD® technology minimizing cheek sagging and pain. Simultaneously targets dermis and fascia layers for immediate lifting effect and sustained elasticity through collagen remodeling.

items.name: Onda
items.desc: Italy's DEKA patented Coolwaves™ microwave technology (2.45GHz) delivers 80% of energy directly to the fat layer and only 20% to the skin. The cooling system protects the skin surface while achieving fat reduction and contouring simultaneously.

injection.intro: Skin changes are not just surface-level issues but result from complex interactions between skin structure, muscles, fat, and moisture balance. Fillers, Botox, skin boosters, and fat-dissolving injections each address different causes, helping manage wrinkles, loss of elasticity, contour changes, and skin condition decline. Dittocell provides injection treatments based on authentic products and proper dosages with both safety and satisfaction in mind.

items.name: Filler
items.desc: We perform customized filler treatments by comprehensively analyzing skin thickness, fat distribution, and facial structure to apply precisely where needed.

items.name: Botox
items.desc: We provide customized Botox treatments that preserve natural expression while refining lines, considering muscle movement and facial balance.

items.name: Fat Dissolving Injection
items.desc: We provide customized fat-dissolving solutions that consider contours and balance, not just simple reduction.

booster.intro: Skin boosters deliver nutrients directly into the skin, enhancing skin regeneration and restoring elasticity and hydration. With products like Juvelook, Radiesse, Revive, and Rejuran, we provide customized solutions for individual skin concerns.

items.name: Juvelook
items.desc: US FDA and Korean KFDA approved collagen-stimulating skin booster. PDLLA and hyaluronic acid work together with effects visible from 3-4 days post-treatment, excellent for pore reduction, acne scar improvement, and skin texture refinement.

items.name: Radiesse
items.desc: Calcium Hydroxylapatite (CaHA) stimulates fibroblast cell activity. Fills volume immediately upon injection while calcium particles act as scaffolding, continuously inducing collagen and elastin production with 27% dermis thickness increase at 7 months.

items.name: Revive
items.desc: Dual-action skin booster combining hyaluronic acid and glycerol. Glycerol's anti-inflammatory and anti-irritation effects with hyaluronic acid's moisturizing benefits restore sensitive skin barrier and create smooth, radiant skin.

items.name: Rejuran
items.desc: Salmon-derived PN with 95%+ DNA compatibility with humans minimizes foreign body reactions. Actively cares for damaged skin barrier, increases skin density and thickness, effective for collagen production, oil-moisture balance, and pore reduction.
